properties.property: Block signer MUST be a member of the current authorized signer set
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. is_valid(block) => signer(block) ∈ authorized_signers(block.parent)
properties.rationale: Only authorized signers can produce valid blocks. Unauthorized signers attempting to produce blocks constitutes an attack.

properties.property: No signer may produce more than 1 block in floor(N/2)+1 consecutive blocks
properties.formal_spec: forall signer: SIGNER, window: BLOCK_SEQUENCE. |window| == floor(N/2)+1 => count(blocks_by(signer, window)) <= 1
properties.rationale: The signing limit prevents any single signer from dominating block production, ensuring decentralization even among authorized signers.

properties.property: Block timestamp MUST be at least parent_timestamp + BLOCK_PERIOD
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.timestamp >= block.parent.timestamp + BLOCK_PERIOD
properties.rationale: Timestamp validation prevents signers from creating blocks faster than the intended block interval.

properties.property: Block extraData MUST contain 32-byte VANITY prefix and 65-byte SEAL suffix
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. len(block.extraData) >= 97 && has_vanity(block.extraData, 32) && has_seal(block.extraData, 65)
properties.rationale: The extraData format is essential for signature recovery and signer identification.

properties.property: Epoch blocks MUST contain complete signer list in extraData with nonce=0 and beneficiary=0
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. is_epoch(block) => contains_signer_list(block.extraData) && block.nonce == 0 && block.beneficiary == 0
properties.rationale: Checkpoint blocks establish authoritative signer list snapshots for light client sync.

properties.property: Signer set changes MUST require majority (floor(N/2)+1) votes
properties.rationale: Majority requirement prevents minority of signers from taking over the signer set.

properties.property: All votes for a beneficiary MUST be discarded after signer set change
properties.rationale: Discarding votes prevents stale votes from affecting future voting rounds.

properties.property: In-turn signers MUST set difficulty=2, out-of-turn signers MUST set difficulty=1
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. is_inturn(signer(block), block.number) => block.difficulty == 2 && ¬is_inturn(signer(block), block.number) => block.difficulty == 1
properties.rationale: Difficulty values enable fork choice to prefer in-turn blocks, reducing chain reorganizations.

properties.property: In-turn signers MUST wait exactly parent_timestamp + BLOCK_PERIOD before producing
properties.formal_spec: forall signer: SIGNER, block: BLOCK. is_inturn(signer, block.number) => wait_until(block.parent.timestamp + BLOCK_PERIOD)
properties.rationale: Exact timing for in-turn signers ensures deterministic block production order.

properties.property: Out-of-turn signers MUST add random delay of rand(N * 500ms)
properties.formal_spec: forall signer: SIGNER, block: BLOCK. ¬is_inturn(signer, block.number) => extra_delay(signer) ∈ [0, N * 500ms]
properties.rationale: Random delay gives in-turn signers priority and reduces competing block production.

properties.property: Malicious signer MUST be rate-limited by signing limit enforcement
properties.rationale: Even a compromised signer cannot spam the network due to signing limits.

properties.property: Less than 51% of signers MUST NOT be able to modify signer set
properties.rationale: Minority coalitions cannot take over the network through signer set manipulation.

properties.property: All votes MUST be reset at epoch boundaries
properties.rationale: Epoch-based vote reset prevents unbounded vote tracking memory consumption.

properties.property: Network security requires majority of signers to be honest
properties.rationale: 51% attack allows colluding signers to reorganize chain and censor transactions.

properties.property: Blocks from peer nodes MUST undergo full Clique validation
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK, peer: PEER. from_peer(block, peer) => requires_full_clique_validation(block)
properties.rationale: Peer-provided blocks are untrusted and could contain invalid signatures or exceed signing limits.

properties.property: Locally produced blocks MUST also undergo validation before broadcast
properties.rationale: Local signer may have outdated signer set; validation ensures consistency.

properties.property: Contract code starting with 0xEF MUST cause exceptional abort
properties.rationale: 0xEF byte is reserved for future EOF format; blocking now prevents conflicts.

properties.property: Exceptional abort MUST consume all remaining gas
properties.rationale: Gas consumption prevents attackers from probing contract deployment cheaply.

properties.property: Contract code NOT starting with 0xEF MUST be stored successfully
properties.formal_spec: forall code: BYTECODE. code[0] != 0xEF && init_succeeds(code) => is_deployed(code)
properties.rationale: Valid contract code should deploy normally when first byte is not reserved.

properties.property: CREATE opcode MUST validate child contract first byte against 0xEF
properties.rationale: CREATE opcode must enforce the same 0xEF restriction as direct deployments.

properties.property: Failed CREATE due to 0xEF MUST push 0 to stack
properties.rationale: Standard failure behavior allows parent contract to detect and handle CREATE failure.

properties.property: CREATE2 opcode MUST validate returned code first byte against 0xEF
properties.rationale: CREATE2 must enforce identical 0xEF restriction to maintain consistency.

properties.property: CREATE2 address computation MUST be independent of 0xEF check
properties.formal_spec: forall create2: CREATE2_OP. address_computed(create2) == keccak256(0xff ++ sender ++ salt ++ keccak256(init_code))
properties.rationale: Address is computed before init code execution, so 0xEF check doesn't affect address calculation.

properties.property: Empty bytecode (length 0) MUST be allowed to deploy
properties.rationale: Empty code has no first byte, so 0xEF check does not apply. Per AMB-EIP3541-01 resolution.

properties.property: 0xEF restriction MUST only apply at or after HF_BLOCK
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK, code: BYTECODE. applies_ef_check(block, code) <=> block.number >= HF_BLOCK
properties.rationale: Fork activation must be deterministic for network consensus.

properties.property: Pre-fork 0xEF contracts MUST remain callable and valid
properties.formal_spec: forall contract: CONTRACT. deployed_before(contract, HF_BLOCK) && starts_with_ef(contract.code) => is_valid(contract)
properties.rationale: Backward compatibility requires existing 0xEF contracts to continue working.

properties.property: External deployer init code MUST be validated before storing runtime code
properties.rationale: External deployers provide untrusted init code that could attempt to deploy 0xEF code.

properties.property: Weak subjectivity checkpoint MUST be validated before sync
properties.rationale: Invalid checkpoint could lead client to sync to malicious chain state.

properties.property: Node operator providing checkpoint MUST be trusted
properties.formal_spec: forall operator: NODE_OPERATOR, checkpoint: WS_CHECKPOINT. provides(operator, checkpoint) => trusted(operator)
properties.rationale: Checkpoint trust is the foundation of bounded historical data security model.

properties.property: Data younger than HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS MUST be retained
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. age(block) < HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS => is_retained(block.data)
properties.rationale: Retention window ensures data availability for weak subjectivity period.

properties.property: Data older than HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS MAY be pruned
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. age(block) >= HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS => may_prune(block.data)
properties.rationale: Pruning old data reduces storage requirements significantly.

properties.property: Clients SHOULD NOT serve data older than HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS
properties.formal_spec: forall request: DATA_REQUEST. age(request.data) > HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS => should_decline(request)
properties.rationale: Consistent serving behavior ensures network-wide adoption of bounded history.

properties.property: Clients MUST serve data within retention window when requested
properties.formal_spec: forall request: DATA_REQUEST. age(request.data) <= HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS && has_data(request.data) => serves(request)
properties.rationale: Recent data must be available for network synchronization and verification.

properties.property: External historical data MUST be validated against known state roots
properties.rationale: External data sources are untrusted and could provide falsified historical data.

properties.property: External data failing validation MUST be rejected
properties.rationale: Invalid external data could corrupt application state or enable fraud.

properties.property: HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS MUST exceed weak subjectivity period
properties.rationale: Checkpoint data must be available within retention window for new client sync.

properties.property: Block data from peers MUST be stored and subject to pruning rules
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK, peer: PEER. from_peer(block, peer) => subject_to_pruning(block)
properties.rationale: All block data regardless of source follows the same retention policy.

properties.property: Out-of-band historical data sources MUST remain available
properties.rationale: If all external data sources become unavailable, historical data is lost.

properties.property: External data providers MUST NOT centralize historical data access
properties.rationale: Centralization of historical data access creates single point of failure and manipulation risk.
